question: Yoga practitioner Baba Sivanand passes away in Varanasi. In which year did Baba Sivanand receive the Padma Shri award?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**2022**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Yoga practitioner Baba Sivanand passes away in Varanasi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Baba Sivanand**, a revered **yoga practitioner and Padma Shri awardee**, passed away at the age of **128** in **Varanasi**.

 
 
• 
 
He was a **resident of Kashi (Varanasi)** and known for a **disciplined lifestyle focused on yoga, meditation, and spirituality**.

 
 
• 
 
Awarded the **Padma Shri in 2022** for his **exceptional contributions to society through yoga**.

 
 
• 
 
His long life and spiritual dedication made him a **symbol of wellness and inner discipline** in India.
